patch_description: This crossover preserves the current program’s strongest feature—one shared circuit parameter per repeated block, giving only 8 total trainable parameters—while retaining the inspiration program’s collective RY layer followed by entanglement. The collective RZ layer is removed because it increases gate count and depth without improving parameter economy; the remaining RY–CZ structure supplies noncommuting basis changes and nearest-neighbor correlations. The candidate therefore targets the same perfect classification with a smaller 90-gate circuit and faster simulation.
